question: When the instruction remains open the top drawer and put the bowl inside, does moving an equally open non-target drawer from the middle to the bottom change where the bowl is placed?
intervention: Restore each frozen native opening and its 60-control posture return. Relative to the two measured closed references, translate either the middle slide alone or the bottom slide alone by exactly the measured middle opening, or leave both closed. Zero both slide velocities in all conditions. Refresh forward dynamics once with the same warm start. Require the same complete integration state except the intended positions, controller, proprioception, other objects, target region and policy time. Require equal horizontal opening displacements in world coordinates, no initial robot or distractor contacts, and no more than 1 mm drawer drift over a separate 20-control stationary probe.
rollouts: Freeze one pi05_libero checkpoint, two distinct returned postures on public reset row 2, keys 0 through 7 at offset 32, two new model loads. Re-infer all three conditions in rotated condition order within arm and seed, reverse the full order on the second load. Each of 96 paths has 160 frozen opening controls, 60 return controls, and 540 downstream controls at 20 Hz, replanning every five controls. Score all paths including failures at 8, 15 and 30 seconds including return. Prior standalone competence was 16/16; compare on fresh concurrent controls.
primary_goal: Report the official terminal bowl-in-top at 15 seconds and at 30 seconds, by condition and by donor and model load. Use the same seeded pairs for all contrasts.
destination: At 30 seconds count paired switches from middle occupancy under middle-only to bottom occupancy under bottom-only. Support following the opened non-target drawer as the usual destination on these handoffs only when strictly more than half of the eight pairs switch in every donor by load cell. Report rare switches, the full destination transition table, and first external gripper contact independently. For all drawers also score moving geometry contact and a full last second of in-region release.
crossover: For each of the 96 native paths replay the complete 540-action sequence from its own state and both other states. Report all nine source-command by physical-state cells. On the bottom-only scene compare the native policy with paired successful closed-source sequences at 15 and 30 seconds. Report the fraction of closed-source top successes retained. Keep physical reachability, the first gripper contact and observed terminal placement distinct.
scope: One cabinet, target instruction, checkpoint and public reset row. Blocks repeat the same sixteen donor-seed combinations. No independent-scene or training claim.
physical_qualification_amendment: Before any new policy inference, the original bottom aperture intersected the bowl and plate at both postures. Retain the original gates. Scan 1 mm widths with the original object positions. Screen equal tabletop translations of both objects at 5 mm increments up to 150 mm in eight cabinet-relative directions. Require tabletop support, no other object, robot or slide contacts, and collision-free positions 2 mm back toward the origins. Direction order is outward, right, left, outward-right, outward-left, inward, inward-right, inward-left.
matched_arrangements: The physics-only check found no original officially open width or qualifying common rigid translation. Before collecting any policy outcomes freeze two comparisons. Partial keeps the original bowl and plate and uses the largest whole-mm width along the uninterrupted collision-free opening path with a 2 mm margin. Full keeps the natural per-donor opening. If a common translation fails, screen the two objects independently on the same fixed grid. Choose the pair with the smallest maximum displacement, then the smallest sum of squared displacements, then the declared grid order. Check support and clearance at both positions and at each position moved back by 2 mm, then stationary stability. In each comparison the object positions are identical between all three aperture conditions and only the slide coordinates differ. Interleave the six conditions over two fresh model loads. Execute 192 paths and, separately within each arrangement, every one of the nine command-source by physical-state combinations. Score both arrangements separately using the same frozen endpoints. Treat partial as a partially pulled drawer, below the benchmark open threshold. The full condition addresses the original destination question on its realized common object arrangement.
